# Unspecified Software Co.

> Software that brings people closer. Unspecified is an independent software company founded by Clark and Carrie Sell in Spring Grove, Illinois.

Unspecified Software Co. (unspecified.io) builds Troth. The company is founder-owned and founder-run. Clark Sell is available for speaking engagements (keynotes, workshops, podcasts); email clark@unspecified.io with the subject "Speaking inquiry".

## Products and work

- Troth (https://jointroth.co): a private, end-to-end encrypted home for your marriage. iOS. Coming to iPhone in 2026. Built by Clark and Carrie Sell. Contact: clark@jointroth.co
- re/Human (https://joinrehuman.com): the company's earlier community-architecture practice. Past clients include ForceBuilders, The A-List Global, Olive and Atlas Travel, Geneva Autobody, Masterpiece Bookkeeping, and Chicam Studios.
- THAT Conference (https://thatconference.com): founded by Clark Sell.

## People
